args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes for snorkeling and rocky beaches
- Hat with wide brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard or swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for sun protection
- Small backpack for day hikes
- Insect repellent
- Portable first aid kit

LUAU & SPECIAL EVENTS:
- Hawaiian shirt or aloha wear
- Semi-casual outfit for nice dinners
- Dress or nice outfit for the luau

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow for flights
- Earplugs and eye mask
- Small umbrella or rain jacket
- Snacks for travel days
- Travel laundry detergent (for hand washing)
- Ziplock bags for wet items or souvenirs

Based on planned activities:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach → Beach essentials, sunscreen, swimsuit
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay → Snorkel gear, waterproof camera, water shoes
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head → Hiking shoes, water bottle, hat, sunscreen
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor → Comfortable walking shoes, light clothing
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore → Car snacks, portable charger, beach gear
- June 16: Luau experience → Hawaiian attire, nice casual outfit
- June 17: Hotel spa day → Spa attire, relaxation items
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach → Quick-dry clothing, water shoes, waterproof bag
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center → Comfortable walking shoes, light backpack
- June 20: Departure → All packed, travel documents ready
